facts.business: Eimco Elecon (India) Limited designs, manufactures, and services high-performance underground mining equipment and construction equipment.
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with Emtici Marketing LLP during FY2025-26 include commission on sales of Rs 2,182.97 lakhs, purchase of goods/materials of Rs 30.25 lakhs, and rendering of services of Rs 1.84 lakhs, all at arm's length basis and approved by Audit Committee, Board, and Members.
